zh: 我參加 Garmin Run 是因為...
跑者大拜拜之一，必須搶！
en: One of the biggest runner meetups of the year—I had to sign up!
I sign up for any race that looks fun!

zh: 目標賽事之一，11月底是突破PB的好時機！
en: It's one of my goal races—late November is the perfect time to set a new PB!

zh: 從5月報名到今天比賽前…
en: From signing up in May to race day…

zh: 不分賽季，平常都一直在跑啦
en: I run year-round, whether it's race season or not.
A full serving of training, every day!
Packing my gear the night before the race

zh: 儀式感要有，裝備排好來張大合照！
en: A race-day ritual: lay out my gear and take a big group photo!

zh: 該帶的塞進衣保袋、晶片綁好，睡飽比較重要啦
en: Pack what I need in the gear-check bag, secure my timing chip, and get a good night's sleep—that's what matters.

zh: 鞋子、手錶、果膠…必須萬無一失！
en: Shoes, watch, gels… everything has to be dialed in!
Before I reach the aid station

zh: 看準空檔，精準進站！遠離人群！
en: Spot the opening, make a precise stop, and stay clear of the crowd!

zh: 終於可以休息！ 看看有什麼好吃的?
en: Finally, a break! Let's see what snacks are on offer.

zh: 優雅地拿出自己的軟水杯／軟水壺裝水
en: I gracefully pull out my own soft cup or flask and fill it up.
Ready! Time to make a stylish stop at the aid station.

zh: All in了！現在不衝什麼時候衝！
en: All in! If not now, when?

image_alt_en: Illustration of the Race Collector runner
slogan_zh: 跑的是賽事，收的是回憶！
slogan_en: I run for the races and collect the memories!

image_alt_en: Illustration of the Easygoing Cruiser runner
slogan_zh: 跑步是生活，比賽是日常！
slogan_en: Running is part of life; races are part of my routine!

image_alt_en: Illustration of the Pace Calculator runner
slogan_zh: 追逐PB是我跑下去的動力！
slogan_en: Chasing a PB keeps me going!

description_zh: 不用跟人擠，想喝就喝，還能外帶點食物
description_en: Skip the crowd: sip whenever you like, and even bring along a snack.

description_zh: 用自己的杯子，慢慢休我就Chill~~
description_en: Bring your own cup, take your time, and chill~~

zh: 懂玩! 你已經帶上自己補水裝備
en: You know how to enjoy race day—you've brought your own hydration gear!
description_zh: 也邀請身邊的跑友一起試試不同的補水方式
description_en: Invite your running friends to try a different way to hydrate, too.

description_zh: 不用跟人擠，想補就補維持自己節奏
description_en: Skip the crowd and stay in your own rhythm—refill whenever you need.

description_zh: 輕到沒有存在感，還能在水站休一下
description_en: So light you barely notice it, and perfect for taking a breather at the aid station.

zh: 不愧是專業跑者，不忘帶上自己補水裝備
en: That's what we call a pro—you remembered your own hydration gear!
description_zh: 也邀請身邊的跑友一起試試不同的補水方式
description_en: Invite your running friends to try a different way to hydrate, too.

description_zh: 偶爾也可以喘口氣，以不同的方式體驗賽道
description_en: Take a breather once in a while and experience the course another way.

description_zh: 該休還是要休一下，帶著輕到沒有存在感
description_en: Even the focused need a break—bring a cup so light you'll barely notice it.

zh: 神人級! 這樣速還帶上自己補水裝備!
en: Incredible! You're moving this fast and still brought your own hydration gear!
description_zh: 也邀請身邊的跑友一起試試不同的補水方式
description_en: Invite your running friends to try a different way to hydrate, too.
